selection: 512 H837 hash-selected documents from existing corpus pool, exclude all2560 H681 plus1024 H824 document hashes and128-token window hashes. One deterministic sampled position each.
fit: None; all20 H836 checkpoints frozen, both seeds, plus rank64 global/residual/weighted/routed-weighted H832/H833 baselines.
probes: Eight new orthonormal Gaussian raw directions seed837+layer, plus recipient native attention-output direction normalized to unit norm. The latter is a state-dependent write direction, not a donor swap or validated task direction.

downstream_lock.reference: natural finite MLP response; compare approximate derivative responses and zero MLP response; preserve skip perturbation

scope: New to early-featurizer panels; source pool reused research documents. No new model-training holdout or corpus acquisition. Confirmation selection includes all token identities, seen/unseen retained.
